rules.description: Every recommended name must exist in the live `dz registry` (no fabricated skill/preset/package names).
Install command must match the item type (skill -> 'dz init --select'; preset -> 'dz setup --preset'; npx-package -> 'npx @dzhechkov/<name> init').
At least one gap-check must be performed (the `gaps` array must be present; empty is allowed only after an explicit check).
No fabricated names — each recommendation must be verifiable against the catalog snapshot or live registry output.
Multi-step tasks must include an ordered `pipeline` of two or more recommended names.
Each recommendation must carry a non-empty `why` rationale.
`fit` must be one of high|medium|low and the list should be ranked best-fit first.
